rejection_summary.title: The Foreigner
rejection_summary.reason: Independent whole-film reviews describe extensive political plotting and long stretches with little Jackie Chan screen time; its intermittent combat cannot establish the required sustained action density.

rejection_summary.title: The Ministry of Ungentlemanly Warfare
rejection_summary.reason: Review evidence identifies a substantial middle act of setup and underwhelming, repetitive action payoff; sustained action density and variety are not established.

rejection_summary.title: The Fugitive
rejection_summary.reason: A strongly reviewed pursuit thriller, but its continuous suspense and narrative momentum cannot substitute for evidence of frequent physical action across the full runtime.
